title: Rizia/Turn 10/DEFAULT GATHERING SCENE/DEFAULT HOUSE AZARO CONVO

3.speaker: Narrator
3.text: The general turned his wheelchair around to face me.

4.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
4.text: "Congratulations on a successful evening, Your Majesty."

5.speaker: Player_Romus
5.text: "I can't tell you how happy I am to see you back in good health, General."
5.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLC.Council_Security_Taddeus"] == false  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Pales_War"] == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Lucita_Married"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.BirthdayGathering_Invited_Carlos"] == true) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Birthday_Default_Azaro_Health"] == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Lucita_Married"] == true) and ((Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Birthday_Default_Azaro_Succession"] == false) == false)

6.speaker: Player_Romus
6.text: "You haven't said a word about my new partner. Do you approve?"
6.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Lucita_Married"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.BirthdayGathering_Invited_Carlos"] == true) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Birthday_Default_Azaro_Partner"] == false  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Pabel_RelationshipPublic"] == true) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Lucita_Married"] == true) and ((Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Birthday_Default_Azaro_Succession"] == false) == false)

8.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
8.text: "The doctors are calling it a miracle recovery."

12.speaker: Player_Romus
12.text: "What do you make of all the recent protests, General?"
12.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Birthday_Default_Azaro_Unrest"] == false  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Order_Unrest_NationalDestabilization"] == true) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Lucita_Married"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.BirthdayGathering_Invited_Carlos"] == true) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Lucita_Married"] == true) and ((Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Birthday_Default_Azaro_Succession"] == false) == false)

16.speaker: Player_Romus
16.text: "You seem to be in good health these days, General."
16.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Council_Security_Taddeus"] == false  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Pales_War"] == false) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Lucita_Married"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.BirthdayGathering_Invited_Carlos"] == true) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Birthday_Default_Azaro_Health"] == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Lucita_Married"] == true) and ((Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Birthday_Default_Azaro_Succession"] == false) == false)

17.speaker: Player_Romus
17.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Lucita_Married"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.BirthdayGathering_Invited_Carlos"] == true) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Birthday_Default_Azaro_General"] == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Lucita_Married"] == true) and ((Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Birthday_Default_Azaro_Succession"] == false) == false)

18.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
18.text: "As both your security councilor and a high-ranking noble, I'm obviously concerned."

22.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
22.text: "I have to say I'm concerned, Your Majesty."

23.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
23.text: "I recognize the feeling in the air. It was exactly the same in 1926."

24.speaker: Player_Romus
24.text: "I believe we can put an end to the unrest. But I will need House Azaro's support."

25.speaker: Player_Romus
25.text: "That revolt could have ended peacefully had the Crown been willing to meet the protesters' demands for reform."

26.speaker: Player_Romus
26.text: "I understand now why my father made that deal with Wehlen. Desperation can make a ruler contemplate the unthinkable."

30.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
30.text: "In fact, I would say I'm well enough to assume my prior position on the Royal Council."

34.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
34.text: "With careful management, I could stay on the Royal Council for years to come."

42.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
42.text: "Very much so, Your Majesty. The doctors call it a miracle recovery."

44.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
44.text: "Have you forgotten that they killed my brother? That they almost killed you?"

45.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
45.text: "These people can't be compromised with. They will be satisfied with nothing less than our blood."

46.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
46.text: "And what are you thinking now, Your Majesty?"

47.speaker: Player_Romus
47.text: "It is a pity to be losing so many trusted advisors. But I am following the path of God now."

48.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
48.text: "Except that the Royal Council is about to dissolve."

49.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
49.text: "Except, of course, that you saw fit to replace my disgraced daughter with your bodyguard."

51.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
51.text: "Except, of course, that the Royal Council is about to dissolve."

52.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
52.text: "I don't want the traitors to win any more than you do, Your Majesty."

53.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
53.text: "But I must say, it won't be easy for us to help you without the ability to mobilize our own forces."

57.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
57.text: "If His Majesty would have me, of course."

58.speaker: Player_Romus
58.text: "I will handle the riots and bring peace to the realm. Your province need not get involved."

65.speaker: Lucita Azaro
65.text: "I agree, Father. The time for peaceful compromise is long past."

66.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
66.text: "We are already involved, Your Majesty. There are riots on our streets as well as yours."

67.speaker: Carlos Robles Azaro
67.text: "Enough with the false modesty, Taddeus. His Majesty is lucky to have you."

71.speaker: Lucita Azaro
71.text: "I don't just allow it, I encourage it. I'll have my hands full raising our new heir."

72.speaker: Lucita Azaro
72.text: "Of course, Father. I was only keeping your seat warm for you, anyway."

73.speaker: Narrator
73.text: There was reluctance in Lucita's voice as she answered.

74.speaker: Player_Romus
74.text: "I had my reasons for appointing Titus. The Azaros could not be trusted after what Lucita did."

75.speaker: Player_Romus
75.text: "Captain Gordion is more than a mere bodyguard. His seat on my council is well deserved."

76.speaker: Player_Romus
76.text: "You were not yet fully recovered back then. Petition for the security councilor seat this year, and I will consider reinstating you."

79.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
79.text: "I will gladly do so, Your Majesty."

81.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
81.text: "I do not question Gordion's competence. But I will point to my years of experience serving your father."

82.speaker: Player_Romus
82.text: "I nonetheless thank you for your many years of service. You deserve a long, happy retirement."

83.speaker: Player_Romus
83.text: "Fear not, General. There will still be a place for you when Rizia is reborn."

84.speaker: Player_Romus
84.text: "As is its destiny. All things must come to an end, Taddeus."

85.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
85.text: "Yes... I know. But I wish I could have served you for longer."

86.speaker: Player_Romus
86.text: "Your daughter has gone above and beyond in her service to the Crown, Taddeus. You should be proud of her."

87.speaker: Player_Romus
87.text: "With all due respect, the time of King Valero has passed. The Royal Council needs fresh blood."

88.speaker: Player_Romus
88.text: "Petition for the council seat when the time comes, General. I will place you under special consideration."

89.speaker: Player_Romus
89.text: "Now, Lucita, I thought you were a modern woman. You can raise a child and have a career at the same time."

95.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
95.text: "I will be once we win the war."

99.speaker: Carlos Robles Azaro
99.text: "If it's fresh blood you're looking for, I could put myself forward."

100.speaker: Lucita Azaro
100.text: "I hadn't heard. But raising a child, fulfilling my duties as Queen Consort *and* serving on your council? It's too much, Romus."

101.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
101.text: "Thank you. You will be hearing from me."

103.speaker: Lucita Azaro
103.text: "Don't discount my father's years of experience, both serving King Valero and leading our troops."

105.speaker: Lucita Azaro
105.text: "I don't think you have the temperament to sit through a lengthy council session, Carlos."

107.speaker: Lucita Azaro
107.text: "With that said, if you did insist I continue my council duties, I could hardly refuse His Majesty's request."

109.speaker: Player_Romus
109.text: "I made a royal decree to centralize our armed forces. I cannot simply reverse it."

110.speaker: Player_Romus
110.text: "I see what you're getting at, but it's not going to happen. I can't grant Rizia's royal houses the means to strike against me."

111.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
111.text: "You're so afraid of being usurped that you'd let the revolutionaries strike against us all?"

112.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
112.text: "I didn't want to say this, but you sound just like your father."

116.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
116.text: "And why not? You are the King -- for now."

117.speaker: Player_Romus
117.text: "No, I cannot authorize this. I command you to help the Crown against the revolutionaries with whatever other resources are at your disposal."

120.speaker: Narrator
120.text: Taddeus and Lucita looked at one another.

121.speaker: Lucita Azaro
121.text: "In addition, we want your assurance that should my child be a boy, he will take his rightful place as successor to the Rizian throne."

126.speaker: Narrator
126.text: I saw Carlos' hands form fists.

127.speaker: Narrator
127.text: I saw Lucita's hands form fists.

128.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
128.text: "Your Majesty, I promise we will help you as best we can, under the circumstances."

129.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
129.text: "The unrest will come to all of us sooner or later. As it did back then."

130.speaker: Player_Romus
130.text: "Nonetheless, I'm reluctant to resort to violence. I'm holding out hope this can be resolved by other means."

131.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
131.text: "But with most of our house embroiled in the war, we don't have the resources to properly crack down on them."

139.speaker: Lucita Azaro
139.text: "We want your assurance that should our child be a boy, he will take his rightful place in the Rizian line of succession."

140.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
140.text: "This is not only what House Azaro wants. It will bring stability and strength back to the kingdom in the wake of the uprising."

141.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
141.text: "The Azaro army will help you to the best of our ability."

143.speaker: Carlos Robles Azaro
143.text: "Loud and clear, General. The rebellion doesn't stand a chance."

146.speaker: Player_Romus
146.text: "I'm sorry, Lucita, but I can't guarantee that."

147.speaker: Player_Romus
147.text: "Of course royal tradition will be respected. If we have a boy, he will inherit the throne."

148.speaker: Player_Romus
148.text: "I have no idea if Vina is even alive or dead. As far as I'm concerned, Lucita's child is my only heir."

154.speaker: Player_Romus
154.text: "I made a promise to Vina long ago. I can't break it."

155.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
155.text: "But I think we should change the subject."

156.speaker: Player_Romus
156.text: "You may be right. Does that mean House Azaro will support the Crown in the fight against the revolutionaries?"

160.speaker: Player_Romus
160.text: "My mother's portrait. Do you like it?"
160.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Lucita_Married"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.BirthdayGathering_Invited_Carlos"] == true) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Lucita_Married"] == true) and ((Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Birthday_Default_Azaro_Succession"] == false) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Birthday_Default_Azaro_Portrait"] == false)

164.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
164.text: "The depiction you chose truly brought a tear to my eye, Your Majesty."

168.speaker: Lucita Azaro
168.text: "When we win Pales, it will become a reality."
168.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLC.Pales_War"] == true) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Path_Stratocracy"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Lucita_DiscussedStratocracy"] == true) == false)

169.speaker: Carlos Robles Azaro
169.text: "Should Rizia find itself at war again, the Queen Mother will be one of our top recruits."
169.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Pales_War"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Path_Stratocracy"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Lucita_DiscussedStratocracy"] == true) == false)

170.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
170.text: "Ah... I'm no art critic, Your Majesty."

171.speaker: Lucita Azaro
171.text: "It was a beautiful tribute, Romus. Everyone here thinks so."

178.speaker: Carlos Robles Azaro
178.text: "Nor am I. But it definitely looked like the Queen Mother."

180.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
180.text: "But if you say the Crown has the situation under control, I will not challenge you."

181.speaker: Carlos Robles Azaro
181.text: "Agreed. The time for peaceful compromise is long past."

182.speaker: Player_Romus
182.text: "A willingness to compromise is what makes a truly great leader. I know the Crown and the protesters will see eye to eye in the end."

183.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
183.text: "You have more faith in the commoners than I do... But perhaps you're right."

184.speaker: Player_Romus
184.text: "And what would House Azaro do in my place?"

185.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
185.text: "We wouldn't let the traitors win. That's for certain."

186.speaker: Lucita Azaro
186.text: "That's not entirely true, Father. We could pull one of our units from the front and deploy them against the revolutionaries."

192.speaker: Lucita Azaro
192.text: "That's true, Your Majesty. We'd have to increase recruitment for our provincial army in order to get the necessary manpower."

196.speaker: Lucita Azaro
196.text: "Even then, most of our house is embroiled in the war. We'd need to institute a massive recruitment drive in order to get the necessary manpower."

197.speaker: Narrator
197.text: He and Lucita looked at one another.

198.speaker: Player_Romus
198.text: "Excellent. I knew I could count on you."

199.speaker: Player_Romus
199.text: "That's all I wanted to know. I've got to go mingle with the other guests now."

200.speaker: Player_Romus
200.text: "That's all I would have to do to get you on my side? Increase the size of our provincial armies?"

201.speaker: Player_Romus
201.text: "That's all I would have to do to get you on my side? Give the provinces back the ability to raise their own armies?"

202.speaker: Player_Romus
202.text: "I understand. I'll have to solve the problem on my own, then."

203.speaker: Player_Romus
203.text: "Is that your only condition for lending your support? That Rizia bring back our provincial levies?"

204.speaker: Player_Romus
204.text: "Enough of this. I shall deal with the traitors on my own. Including your house, when the time comes."

208.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
208.text: "Are you sure, Your Majesty? The riots greatly affect us in Cardesse-Montaklar as well."

212.speaker: Lucita Azaro
212.text: "You would also have to allow us to double our recruitment numbers, so that we don't have to pull troops from the front."

213.speaker: Player_Romus
213.text: "I was hoping for a solution that didn't involve the military."

215.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
215.text: "Your Majesty, I promise we will help you as best we can, under the circumstances."

216.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
216.text: "I only hope it is not too little, too late."

217.speaker: Narrator
217.text: Taddeus folded his arms across his chest, making sure his medals were still visible.

218.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
218.text: "Your father and I learned this in 1926, Your Majesty. Brute force is the only language these animals speak."

224.speaker: Player_Romus
224.text: "Very well. So you're saying if I reinstate provincial levies, the Azaros will help us against the revolutionaries?"

225.speaker: Player_Romus
225.text: "I don't believe that at all. I will not ask your house to get involved in this."

226.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
226.text: "We will try our best to avoid escalating the situation, Your Majesty."

227.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
227.text: "I wish you the best of luck with it."

228.speaker: Player_Romus
228.text: "I have my own ways of applying brute force, if it comes down to it."

229.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
229.text: "Then it sounds like you don't need us at all."

230.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
230.text: "I wish you the best of luck with the situation."

231.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
231.text: "Give us the capability and the resources, and we will do our part to crush the rebellion to a bloody pulp."

232.speaker: Player_Romus
232.text: "Very well, General. By royal decree, I will bring back Rizia's provincial army system and increase levies to twice their original size." [Restore And Increase Provincial Levies]

236.speaker: Player_Romus
236.text: "Vina wants to be queen more than anything. I can't take that away from her."

237.speaker: Player_Romus
237.text: "For political reasons, I must name my daughter as successor."

238.speaker: Player_Romus
238.text: "Succession law shouldn't favor sons. You have to admit it's a sexist policy."

242.speaker: Lucita Azaro
242.text: "But, Romus... we don't even know where Vina is."

246.speaker: Lucita Azaro
246.text: "And after the way she humiliated you, does she even deserve to be your heir?"

247.speaker: Lucita Azaro
247.text: "We're doing our best to coordinate her rescue, but realistically, she might not make it back."

249.speaker: Narrator
249.text: My wife breathed a sigh of relief.

250.speaker: Lucita Azaro
250.text: "Thank you, Romus. That means so much."

252.speaker: Lucita Azaro
252.text: "Our child will represent the union of House Toras and House Azaro. A new way forward for Rizia."

253.speaker: Narrator
253.text: She looked at me with pleading eyes.

254.speaker: Lucita Azaro
254.text: "I know how much you love Vina. But if she loves you too, she'll understand."

256.speaker: Lucita Azaro
256.text: "Vina will come back, Romus. And when she does, she'll understand."

257.speaker: Player_Romus
257.text: "If we don't band together against the unrest, the protesters could kill us all. Are you seriously willing to put our unborn child's life at risk over this?"

258.speaker: Player_Romus
258.text: "Yes... you're right. *If* we have a son, he will take Vina's place as successor."

259.speaker: Player_Romus
259.text: "We don't even know the sex of our child yet. I will make this decision when the time comes."

266.speaker: Player_Romus
266.text: "Very well, General. By royal decree, I will bring back Rizia's provincial army system." [Restore Provincial Levies]

267.speaker: Player_Romus
267.text: "I understand. I'll have to tackle the problem on my own, then."

271.speaker: Player_Romus
271.text: "Very well. So you're saying if I raise provincial levies, the Azaros will help us against the revolutionaries?"
271.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.BirthdayGathering_Invited_Carlos"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_RD_Order_RemoveProvincialLevies"] == true) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Pales_War"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Army_Unit_Azaro_Total"] < 2)

272.speaker: Player_Romus
272.text: "Yes, I'm sure. Let's change the subject."

273.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
273.text: "We can offer a unit from our provincial army. With no wars on the horizon, our men and women have been looking for a fight."

277.speaker: Player_Romus
277.text: "Very well. I request that you deploy your forces to quell the rebellion."
277.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.BirthdayGathering_Invited_Carlos"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_RD_Order_RemoveProvincialLevies"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Pales_War"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Army_Unit_Azaro_Total"] < 2) == false)

281.speaker: Lucita Azaro
281.text: "Yes, I wish we could help. But even with provincial recruitment at a maximum, House Azaro can't spare the troops."

282.speaker: Player_Romus
282.text: "I command you to aid the Crown with whatever resources are at your disposal."

283.speaker: Player_Romus
283.text: "I understand. I won't burden your house with this on top of the war."

284.speaker: Narrator
284.text: She breathed a sigh of relief.

285.speaker: Player_Romus
285.text: "If you truly love *me*, you'll understand why I have to put my daughter first."

287.speaker: Narrator
287.text: She looked at her father apologetically.

288.speaker: Lucita Azaro
288.text: "I'm not. Father, we have to do something."

291.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
291.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_RD_Order_RemoveProvincialLevies"] == false)  or  (Variable["RiziaDLC.Pales_War"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_RD_Order_IncreaseProvincialLevies"] == false)) == false

294.speaker: Narrator
294.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_RD_Order_RemoveProvincialLevies"] == false)  or  (Variable["RiziaDLC.Pales_War"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_RD_Order_IncreaseProvincialLevies"] == false)) == false

296.speaker: Lucita Azaro
296.text: "Father... if the revolution succeeds, there won't even be a throne for our child to inherit."

297.speaker: Narrator
297.text: Lucita sighed in frustration. She looked at her father apologetically.

301.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
301.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_RD_Order_RemoveProvincialLevies"] == false)  or  (Variable["RiziaDLC.Pales_War"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_RD_Order_IncreaseProvincialLevies"] == false)) == false

302.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
302.text: "And as for our troops, Your Majesty?"

303.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
303.text: "In that case, Your Majesty, House Azaro is at your disposal."
303.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_RD_Order_RemoveProvincialLevies"] == false)  or  (Variable["RiziaDLC.Pales_War"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_RD_Order_IncreaseProvincialLevies"] == false)) == false

304.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
304.text: "Did you hear that, Carlos? I want you to send word to Camp Domus about this immediately."

308.speaker: Lucita Azaro
308.text: "I'll send the word to Camp Domus immediately. The rebellion doesn't stand a chance."

309.speaker: Player_Romus
309.text: "Very well, General. By royal decree, I will increase provincial levies, on the condition that House Azaro form a unit to deploy against the unrest." [Increase Provincial Levies]

310.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
310.text: "Thank you for your trust in us, Your Majesty."

311.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
311.text: "Carlos, I want you to get word to Camp Domus about this immediately. There's no time to waste, understand?"

312.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
312.text: "Thank you for your trust in us. We will not fail you."

318.speaker: Player_Romus
318.text: "All three houses, defending the Crown together. This will be a triumph to remember."

322.speaker: Player_Romus
322.text: "I did away with provincial levies for a reason. I still think it's too risky for provinces like Cardesse-Montaklar to command their own armies."

323.speaker: Player_Romus
323.text: "The Azaro army is large enough already. You will help crack down on the traitors with the troops you currently have."

324.speaker: Player_Romus
324.text: "My deepest apologies, but I cannot grant your request. It is not your house I distrust, but the others."

325.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
325.text: "Then there is nothing we can do, Your Majesty."

331.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
331.text: "We will try, but I fear it will not be enough."

332.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
332.text: "If the noble houses can't trust each other after all this time, perhaps Rizia deserves to fall."

334.speaker: Narrator
334.text: The Azaros bowed and walked to the far corner of the room.

348.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
348.text: "To be honest, Your Majesty, the protests are beginning to worry me."
348.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Birthday_Default_Azaro_Unrest"] == true) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Order_Unrest_NationalDestabilization"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Order_ViolentProtests_CardesseMontaklar"] == true)

356.speaker: Carlos Robles Azaro
356.text: "Yes, we are doing our best to contain what's happening in our province. But the fury with which people have taken to the streets is quite alarming."

360.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
360.text: "As well as can be, Your Majesty."
360.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Birthday_Default_Azaro_Unrest"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Order_Unrest_NationalDestabilization"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Order_ViolentProtests_CardesseMontaklar"] == true) == false)

361.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
361.text: "The announcement of Rizia's new theocratic direction threw many of us for a loop, myself included."
361.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Order_Unrest_NationalDestabilization"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.BirthdayGathering_Invited_Carlos"] == true) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Theocracy_Full"] == true)

365.speaker: Lucita Azaro
365.text: "It was a surprise to many of us in the capital as well, Father."

369.speaker: Carlos Robles Azaro
369.text: "Don't get me wrong, I'm an observant Wruhecist. But the dissolution of the Royal Council? It will take some time to get used to."

371.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
371.text: "I will tell you that some in our province are still outraged over Duchess Lucita's imprisonment, as justified as it may be."
371.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Order_Unrest_NationalDestabilization"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.BirthdayGathering_Invited_Carlos"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Theocracy_Full"] == true) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Lucita_Arrested"] == true)

372.speaker: Player_Romus
372.text: "Lucita, you told me some time ago that House Azaro had complaints about my reign. Is that still the case?"

376.speaker: Lucita Azaro
376.text: "Father is being too diplomatic to tell you that Rumburg's sudden intervention in the Pales war was not well received."

380.speaker: Lucita Azaro
380.text: "Father is being too diplomatic to tell you that our decision to bring Wehlen into the Pales war was not particularly well received."

384.speaker: Lucita Azaro
384.text: "Father is too modest. You'll be rechristening the streets in the Palesian capital in no time."
384.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.War_RumburgCeasefireRequested"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.War_WehlenJoined"] == true) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.War_Objective_Captured_Pales"] == true)

385.speaker: Carlos Robles Azaro
385.text: "We continue to watch our Palesian neighbors with caution. There are those who believe Reinhart's conciliatory attitude is all an act."
385.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Order_Unrest_NationalDestabilization"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.BirthdayGathering_Invited_Carlos"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Theocracy_Full"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Lucita_Arrested"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Pales_War"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.War_WehlenJoined"] == true) == false)

386.speaker: Carlos Robles Azaro
386.text: "Not that I am one of them."

387.speaker: Lucita Azaro
387.text: "But as long as Pales is restored to us, House Azaro will be happy to see an end to the fighting."

388.speaker: Lucita Azaro
388.text: "But with time, our citizens will see the necessity of your decision."

399.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
399.text: "The war continues to strain resources, but our house remains optimistic."
399.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Order_Unrest_NationalDestabilization"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.BirthdayGathering_Invited_Carlos"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Theocracy_Full"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Lucita_Arrested"] == true) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Pales_War"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.War_WehlenJoined"] == true)

400.speaker: Narrator
400.text: Lucita shot him a troubled glance.
400.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.War_RumburgCeasefireRequested"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.War_WehlenJoined"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.War_Objective_Captured_Pales"] == true) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.War_Pales_Operation1_Won"] == false)

404.speaker: Narrator
404.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.War_RumburgCeasefireRequested"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.War_WehlenJoined"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.War_Objective_Captured_Pales"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.War_Pales_Operation1_Won"] == false) == false)

405.speaker: Lucita Azaro
405.text: "We'll deliver a full report on Total Tranquility later. Now's not the time for war talk."

407.speaker: Lucita Azaro
407.text: "We'll deliver a full report later. Now's not the time for war talk."

408.speaker: Player_Romus
408.text: "You've caught me in a good mood. Is there anything your house requests of your King today?"

412.speaker: Player_Romus
412.text: "I hope that our holy kingdom can count on your continued support. We will need your military prowess for the many crusades ahead."

413.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
413.text: "Still, we are prepared to support the Crown through the transition."

414.speaker: Player_Romus
414.text: "I hope I can count on the Azaros' continued support. You are among my family's oldest and most important allies."

415.speaker: Narrator
415.text: Taddeus glared at his daughter sternly.

417.speaker: Player_Romus
417.text: "With the House of Delegates abolished and the royal houses of Toras and Azaro united once more, I've been thinking the military should play a greater role in how Rizia is governed."
417.conditionsRaw: Variable["RiziaDLC.Lucita_DiscussedStratocracy"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Lucita_Married"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.HouseOfDelegates_Abolished"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Theocracy_Full"] == false  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Reform_Path"] == false

419.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
419.conditionsRaw: Variable["RiziaDLC.Lucita_DiscussedStratocracy"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Lucita_Married"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.HouseOfDelegates_Abolished"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Theocracy_Full"] == false  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Reform_Path"] == false

420.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
420.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLC.Lucita_DiscussedStratocracy"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Lucita_Married"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.HouseOfDelegates_Abolished"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Theocracy_Full"] == false  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Reform_Path"] == false) == false

421.speaker: Narrator
421.text: Lucita slipped her hand in mine and smiled.

423.speaker: Player_Romus
423.text: "Thanks to you and your house for joining us tonight. If you'll excuse me, I'm going to freshen up my drink."
423.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Lucita_Married"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.BirthdayGathering_Invited_Carlos"] == true) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Lucita_Married"] == true) and ((Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Birthday_Default_Azaro_Succession"] == false) == false)

428.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
428.text: "I can tell you now that the late King Valero always had his suspicions about your... leanings. But having seen you and Princess Lena together, I never would have guessed."

435.speaker: Lucita Azaro
435.text: "To be honest, I wasn't surprised in the least."

436.speaker: Narrator
436.text: She looked me in the eye.

437.speaker: Lucita Azaro
437.text: "My most heartfelt of congratulations to you and Mr. Adria. I mean it."

438.speaker: Carlos Robles Azaro
438.text: "It's an unusual predilection for a Rizian king. But you and Mr. Adria have my most heartfelt of congratulations."

440.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
440.text: "I can tell you now that the late King Valero always had his suspicions about your... leanings. But having seen you in action in the military, I was shocked to hear the news."

444.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
444.text: "I can tell you now that the late King Valero always had his suspicions about your... leanings. I never would have guessed, myself."

448.speaker: Lucita Azaro
448.text: "Father. Are you saying that one can't prefer the company of men and be a skilled soldier at the same time?"

449.speaker: Carlos Robles Azaro
449.text: "Look at the Derdians, Taddeus. Hell, I'm beginning to think we should mandate homosexuality in basic training."

451.speaker: Player_Romus
451.text: "Mandatory homosexuality in the military... I feel a new decree coming on."

455.speaker: Player_Romus
455.text: "You had better mean it. Anyone who dares to challenge the legitimacy of the King's new partnership is a traitor to the realm."

459.speaker: Player_Romus
459.text: "What exactly did my father say about me, General Taddeus?"

460.speaker: Player_Romus
460.text: "I hope all of Cardesse-Montaklar shares your tolerance."

461.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
461.text: "We will see to it that they do."

462.speaker: Narrator
462.text: Horrified looks spread across the Azaros' faces.

463.speaker: Carlos Robles Azaro
463.text: "That was meant as a joke, Your Majesty."

464.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
464.text: "Your Majesty... perhaps those opinions are best left buried with him."

467.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
467.text: "We are all very happy for you, Your Majesty. We'll see to it that Cardesse-Montaklar celebrates your new love as well."

468.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
468.text: "It will take some time for the people of our province to accept this news. But we'll see to it that they do."

473.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
473.text: "I wasn't very lucid at the time, but I do recall talk amongst our house that you had intentions to reform the monarchy against the nobility's will."

475.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
475.text: "Your Majesty, I assure you that House Azaro does not harbor any ill will against the Crown."

476.speaker: Player_Romus
476.text: "Who was spreading such rumors? Tell me, and I'll have them hanged."

477.speaker: Player_Romus
477.text: "Yes, you were. There will be no anti-nobility reforms on King Romus' watch, mark my words."

481.speaker: Player_Romus
481.text: "*If* I were planning to reform the country, I would not do so against your house's will."

485.speaker: Player_Romus
485.text: "I allowed Manus Sazon to plead his case for reform, yes. But ultimately, I rejected his misguided ideas."

486.speaker: Player_Romus
486.text: "Surely you don't believe that Rizia can stay the same forever. A kingdom must adapt to the changing times and the will of its people."

489.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
489.text: "That may be so. But such decisions must be made in consultation with provincial leaders."

491.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
491.text: "Hmm. So you don't deny your intentions?"

492.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
492.text: "Especially not since one of our own is now a part of the Royal Family."

493.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
493.text: "Especially not on the Queen Mother's birthday."

497.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
497.text: "If that is indeed the case, then I assure you House Azaro does not harbor any ill will towards the Crown."

499.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
499.text: "In any case, Your Majesty, you must believe that House Azaro harbors no ill will against the Crown."

508.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
508.text: "Now that victory in Pales is all but a certainty, House Azaro humbly wishes to resume its governance of the region."

509.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
509.text: "Should we achieve victory in Pales, House Azaro humbly wishes to resume its governance of the region."

510.speaker: Player_Romus
510.text: "Resume? Pales hasn't even been a part of Rizia for over two centuries."

511.speaker: Player_Romus
511.text: "Of course, General. For your service during this war and the one that preceded it, you deserve it."

512.speaker: Lucita Azaro
512.text: "That may be true. But we Azaros have long memories."

516.speaker: Player_Romus
516.text: "Pales will be in a state of instability after it is reconquered. It needs the full attention of the Crown."

517.speaker: Player_Romus
517.text: "We centralized Zille following its return. I was planning on doing the same with Pales."

518.speaker: Narrator
518.text: Taddeus bowed so deeply he almost fell off his wheelchair.

520.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
520.text: "We have fought the Palesians twice. Do you truly believe we can't handle a little instability?"

521.speaker: Lucita Azaro
521.text: "So you would give our house the same treatment as the Sazons? The traitors?"

525.speaker: Player_Romus
525.text: "I don't foresee a happy ending to this war. Chances are that no one in Rizia will end up governing Pales."

526.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
526.text: "Don't count us out just yet, Your Majesty."

527.speaker: Player_Romus
527.text: "If it truly means that much to you, I will consider your request. Once we win, that is."

531.speaker: Player_Romus
531.text: "With Wiktor Smolak now involved, the decision may be out of my hands."

532.speaker: Player_Romus
532.text: "By the time the war is over, the decision may be out of my hands."

536.speaker: Narrator
536.text: Both Azaros looked at me strangely.

537.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
537.text: "What do you mean, out of your hands? You're the King."

538.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
538.text: "We cannot allow Wehlen to control us yet again."

539.speaker: Player_Romus
539.text: "Why do you want Pales so badly, anyway? It'll be a smoking ruin by the time our armies are done with it."

542.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
542.text: "But it will give us the sea, Your Majesty. Something all the other provinces have that we in Cardesse-Montaklar lack."

543.speaker: Lucita Azaro
543.text: "We *will* win Pales. And when we do, I hope you will think of us."

547.speaker: Narrator
547.text: Taddeus and Lucita looked at each other. Finally, Lucita spoke up gently.
547.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Pales_War"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.War_Pales_Operation1_Won"] == true) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Lucita_Married"] == true)

549.speaker: Player_Romus
549.text: "Well, good. I'd hate to think that any of you were plotting against me."

550.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
550.text: "Your Majesty, I can't express how happy I am that you and my daughter are expecting a child."

551.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
551.text: "And my greatest hope is that if that child is male, he will take his rightful place as successor to the throne of Rizia."

552.speaker: Player_Romus
552.text: "I'm sorry, Taddeus, but I cannot guarantee that."

553.speaker: Player_Romus
553.text: "Of course royal tradition will be respected. If we have a boy, he will inherit the throne."

556.speaker: Lucita Azaro
556.text: "Our child will represent the union of House Toras and House Azaro. A new way forward for Rizia."

560.speaker: Player_Romus
560.text: "I have no idea if Vina is even alive or dead. As far as I'm concerned, Lucita's child is my only heir."

564.speaker: Player_Romus
564.text: "I made a promise to Vina long ago. I can't break it."

565.speaker: Lucita Azaro
565.text: "And after the way she humiliated you, does she even deserve to be your heir?"

566.speaker: Lucita Azaro
566.text: "We're doing our best to coordinate her rescue, but realistically, she might not make it back."

567.speaker: Lucita Azaro
567.text: "Thank you, Romus. That means so much."

568.speaker: Narrator
568.text: She looked at me with pleading eyes.

569.speaker: Player_Romus
569.text: "Yes... you're right. *If* we have a son, he will take Vina's place as successor."

571.speaker: Player_Romus
571.text: "We don't even know the sex of our child yet. I will make this decision when the time comes."

572.speaker: Narrator
572.text: She breathed a sigh of relief.

573.speaker: Player_Romus
573.text: "If you truly love *me*, you'll understand why I have to put my daughter first."

575.speaker: Lucita Azaro
575.text: "I know how much you love Vina. But if she loves you too, she'll understand."

576.speaker: Player_Romus
576.text: "What are you saying? Are you *hoping* my daughter never returns?"

577.speaker: Lucita Azaro
577.text: "I am sure His Majesty will make the right decision when the time comes, Father. We shouldn't press the issue while Her Highness is still missing."

578.speaker: Narrator
578.text: Taddeus sighed in frustration. Lucita looked at him apologetically.

579.speaker: Lucita Azaro
579.text: "He's right, Father. We're getting ahead of ourselves."

584.speaker: Player_Romus
584.text: "Vina wants to be queen more than anything. I can't take that away from her."

585.speaker: Player_Romus
585.text: "For political reasons, I must name my daughter as successor."

586.speaker: Player_Romus
586.text: "A male heir ought not to be favored over his female older sibling. I intend to change that sexist policy."

591.speaker: Lucita Azaro
591.text: "But, Romus... we don't even know where Vina is."

592.speaker: Narrator
592.text: My wife breathed a sigh of relief.

594.speaker: Lucita Azaro
594.text: "Vina will come back, Romus. And when she does, she'll understand."

596.speaker: Narrator
596.text: Taddeus sighed in frustration. Lucita looked at him apologetically.

597.speaker: Lucita Azaro
597.text: "I am sure His Majesty will make the right decision when the time comes, Father. We shouldn't press the issue now."

600.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
600.text: "If you can't guarantee us Pales, I would hope you can promise this."

607.speaker: Narrator
607.text: He and Lucita looked at each other.

615.speaker: Narrator
615.text: Carlos smiled, showing all his teeth as he did so.

616.speaker: Carlos Robles Azaro
616.text: "The alliance between our two houses is the bedrock on which Rizia stands, Your Majesty."

621.speaker: Narrator
621.text: Carlos removed his hat and smiled sincerely.

622.speaker: Narrator
622.text: Taddeus put a hand to his chest.

623.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
623.text: "The alliance between our two houses is the bedrock on which Rizia stands, Your Majesty."

625.speaker: Narrator
625.text: I saw a hint of sorrow in Taddeus' eyes.

627.speaker: Carlos Robles Azaro
627.text: "Never in a million years, Your Majesty."

631.speaker: Lucita Azaro
631.text: "I swear you can count on my family's loyalty, {RiziaDLCText.LucitaToPlayer}."

632.speaker: Player_Romus
632.text: "I still have to convince the other houses. But the Azaros are the most vital piece of the puzzle."

637.speaker: Carlos Robles Azaro
637.text: "Taddeus, the Viscount of Nelvisar has been waiting all night to congratulate you on your recovery. Shall we?"

638.speaker: Lucita Azaro
638.text: "Father, the Viscount of Nelvisar has been waiting all night to congratulate you on your recovery. Shall we?"

641.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
641.conditionsRaw: Variable["RiziaDLC.BirthdayGathering_Invited_Carlos"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Lucita_Arrested"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_RD_Welfare_RemoveDeathPenalty"] == false

642.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
642.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLC.BirthdayGathering_Invited_Carlos"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Lucita_Arrested"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_RD_Welfare_RemoveDeathPenalty"] == false) == false

643.speaker: Carlos Robles Azaro
643.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Pales_War"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.War_Pales_Operation1_Won"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Lucita_Married"] == true) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.BirthdayGathering_Invited_Carlos"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Lucita_Arrested"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_RD_Welfare_RemoveDeathPenalty"] == false)

644.speaker: Narrator
644.text: Taddeus raised an eyebrow in his direction.

645.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
645.text: "Only that you enjoy the evening as much as we have."

646.speaker: Narrator
646.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Pales_War"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.War_Pales_Operation1_Won"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Lucita_Married"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.BirthdayGathering_Invited_Carlos"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Lucita_Arrested"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_RD_Welfare_RemoveDeathPenalty"] == false) == false)

647.speaker: Carlos Robles Azaro
647.text: "I have visited my cousin -- Lucita -- in prison. She swears she is innocent."

649.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
649.text: "You are most welcome, Your Majesty. But I do wish I could have served you for longer."

650.speaker: Player_Romus
650.text: "Are you saying that you know better than the international courts?"

651.speaker: Player_Romus
651.text: "I'm truly sorry, but I cannot exonerate Lucita as long as Rizia remains allied with Pales."

652.speaker: Player_Romus
652.text: "Of course, she'll never admit to her guilt. I thought you were too smart to fall for her lies."

653.speaker: Player_Romus
653.text: "It doesn't matter. By imprisoning her, we avoided a war that would have cost us thousands of lives."

656.speaker: Carlos Robles Azaro
656.text: "I know Lucita well, Your Majesty. I don't believe she's lying."

659.speaker: Narrator
659.text: Taddeus put a hand on his cousin's shoulder.

660.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
660.text: "Carlos. Do not question the Crown's justice."

661.speaker: Carlos Robles Azaro
661.text: "I am not asking that Lucita be exonerated. Only that her life be spared."

662.speaker: Player_Romus
662.text: "What kind of monster do you think I am, General? I would never execute Duchess Azaro."

663.speaker: Player_Romus
663.text: "The punishment for those who betray the Crown is death. Are you implying the Duchess is above the law?"

664.speaker: Player_Romus
664.text: "Your love for your cousin moves me. I will honor your request and spare her from execution."

665.speaker: Player_Romus
665.text: "Why stop there? Why shouldn't Rizia do away with the death penalty entirely?"

671.speaker: Player_Romus
671.text: "You're right, Carlos. Death is too good for Lucita. Your traitorous cousin should be tortured for the rest of her miserable life."

674.speaker: Carlos Robles Azaro
674.text: "That's most merciful of you, Your Majesty."

675.speaker: Carlos Robles Azaro
675.text: "No... Only that if there is even a slim possibility she is innocent, she should be given the benefit of the doubt."

676.speaker: Carlos Robles Azaro
676.text: "Your Majesty, I still believe that the evildoers of Rizia should be punished to the full extent of the law. But my cousin is not among them."

677.speaker: Player_Romus
677.text: "Everybody is somebody's cousin, aren't they? All criminals should similarly be given the benefit of the doubt."

678.speaker: Player_Romus
678.text: "I was speaking rhetorically. If I spare Lucita, I'll get flooded with requests to spare everyone."

679.speaker: Narrator
679.text: Carlos and Taddeus both gave me looks of offense.

680.speaker: Player_Romus
680.text: "I was joking, Carlos. You know how much I love a good beheading."

685.speaker: Player_Romus
685.text: "Other countries have stopped using this barbaric form of punishment. Perhaps we really should consider it."

686.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
686.text: "That is a discussion for another time, I think."

687.speaker: Carlos Robles Azaro
687.text: "I am speaking on behalf of House Azaro. One of the oldest and most powerful noble families in Rizia."

688.speaker: Carlos Robles Azaro
688.text: "I am not asking for a removal of the death penalty. I am asking for an exception, because this is an exceptional circumstance."

689.speaker: Player_Romus
689.text: "Lucita will live. And I will rethink Rizia's policy of killing criminals."

690.speaker: Player_Romus
690.text: "Don't worry. As long as I am King, your cousin will not be executed."

691.speaker: Player_Romus
691.text: "As long as the death penalty still exists, every Rizian who has committed a serious enough felony will be subject to it. Without exception."

692.speaker: Player_Romus
692.text: "I will consider your house's request. That is all I can promise."

693.speaker: Carlos Robles Azaro
693.text: "I... thank you, Your Majesty. You are most merciful."

696.speaker: Carlos Robles Azaro
696.text: "Please consider our request. That is all I ask."

698.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
698.text: "Carlos. Your Majesty. Perhaps we should leave this be."

699.speaker: Narrator
699.text: His face hardened into a scowl.

700.speaker: Carlos Robles Azaro
700.text: "Your Majesty. I truly beg you to reconsider."

704.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
704.text: "I have certainly appreciated your commitment to strengthening the Rizian armed forces."

705.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
705.text: "Rizia's armed forces are currently too weak to be put in such a position, but with more investment, it could work."

709.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
709.text: "If our troops achieve victory in Pales, the public will not only accept the change, but celebrate it."

713.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
713.text: "If we can overcome the current unrest, I'm sure the public will accept the change."

714.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
714.text: "With my daughter in place as Queen Consort, I would ask that you appoint me to my old seat on the Royal Council to help plan the transition."

715.speaker: Lucita Azaro
715.text: "Realizing Ana Azaro's vision of a monarcho-military alliance. We spoke of this while you were still convalescing, Father."

717.speaker: Narrator
717.text: He and Lucita looked at each other.

718.speaker: Player_Romus
718.text: "Done. There are no other suitable candidates, anyway."

719.speaker: Player_Romus
719.text: "Are you confident you have the health and stamina to resume the position?"

720.speaker: Player_Romus
720.text: "That's it? This will be easier than I thought."

721.speaker: Player_Romus
721.text: "I was hoping to reward Captain Gordion with the position. But I will consider you instead."

723.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
723.text: "As I served His Majesty Valero, so would I pledge to serve you."

724.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
724.text: "If this alliance is to work, the union of Azaro and Toras must last for generations to come."

725.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
725.text: "It is therefore my hope that if your child is male, he will take his rightful place as successor to the throne of Rizia."

726.speaker: Player_Romus
726.text: "I'm sorry, Taddeus, but I cannot guarantee that."

727.speaker: Player_Romus
727.text: "Of course royal tradition will be respected. If we have a boy, he will inherit the throne."

730.speaker: Lucita Azaro
730.text: "Our child will represent the union of House Toras and House Azaro. A new way forward for Rizia."

734.speaker: Player_Romus
734.text: "I have no idea if Vina is even alive or dead. As far as I'm concerned, Lucita's child is my only heir."

738.speaker: Player_Romus
738.text: "I made a promise to Vina long ago. I can't break it."

739.speaker: Lucita Azaro
739.text: "And after the way she humiliated you, does she even deserve to be your heir?"

740.speaker: Lucita Azaro
740.text: "We're doing our best to coordinate her rescue, but realistically, she might not make it back."

741.speaker: Lucita Azaro
741.text: "Thank you, Romus. That means so much."

742.speaker: Narrator
742.text: She looked at me with pleading eyes.

743.speaker: Player_Romus
743.text: "Yes... you're right. *If* we have a son, he will take Vina's place as successor."

745.speaker: Player_Romus
745.text: "We don't even know the sex of our child yet. I will make this decision when the time comes."

746.speaker: Narrator
746.text: She breathed a sigh of relief.

747.speaker: Player_Romus
747.text: "If you truly love *me*, you'll understand why I have to put my daughter first."

749.speaker: Lucita Azaro
749.text: "I know how much you love Vina. But if she loves you too, she'll understand."

750.speaker: Player_Romus
750.text: "What are you saying? Are you *hoping* my daughter never returns?"

751.speaker: Narrator
751.text: Taddeus sighed in frustration. Lucita looked at him apologetically.

756.speaker: Player_Romus
756.text: "Vina wants to be queen more than anything. I can't take that away from her."

757.speaker: Player_Romus
757.text: "For political reasons, I must name my daughter as successor."

758.speaker: Player_Romus
758.text: "A male heir ought not to be favored over his female older sibling. I intend to change that sexist policy."

763.speaker: Lucita Azaro
763.text: "But, Romus... we don't even know where Vina is."

764.speaker: Narrator
764.text: My wife breathed a sigh of relief.

766.speaker: Lucita Azaro
766.text: "Vina will come back, Romus. And when she does, she'll understand."

767.speaker: Narrator
767.text: Taddeus sighed in frustration. Lucita looked at him apologetically.

769.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
769.text: "Your Majesty, if you cannot even commit to follow royal tradition, than I don't see how we can work together."

770.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
770.text: "But of course, the Rizian military is still at your disposal."

778.speaker: Lucita Azaro
778.text: "Our next step should be to establish a headquarters for the military in Porte Drazon. Ideally in or near Palas Rezna..."

779.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
779.text: "But we are getting ahead of ourselves. For now, let's enjoy this evening."

780.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
780.text: "I will submit my petition regardless. I place my fate in your hands."

781.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
781.text: "I was as saddened by my daughter's betrayal as you were. She certainly does not represent all of the Azaros."

784.speaker: Player_Romus
784.text: "Have members of House Azaro expressed any dissatisfaction about my reign?"

789.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
789.text: "At some point during my recovery, I did hear talk amongst our house that you had intentions to reform the monarchy against the nobility's will."

797.speaker: Player_Romus
797.text: "Because if you *were* plotting against me, I would find out. And I would crush your so-called noble house into a million bloody pieces."

801.speaker: Player_Romus
801.text: "I do value honesty among my subjects. If I did find out that any member of House Azaro was planning to challenge the throne, the consequences would be *extremely* dire."

802.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
802.text: "Please, Your Majesty. The Crown has our fealty now and forever."

804.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
804.text: "It was a pleasure speaking with you, Your Majesty."

808.speaker: Narrator
808.text: He saluted once more as Carlos rolled his wheelchair away.

809.speaker: Narrator
809.text: He saluted once more as Lucita rolled his wheelchair away.

817.speaker: Lucita Azaro
817.text: "The Rizian royal family endowed with the strength of the military. A vision of what's to come, perhaps."

829.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
829.text: "As I've mentioned before, the current atmosphere mirrors that of 1926."

835.speaker: Carlos Robles Azaro
835.text: "His Majesty's made himself clear, my cousin."
